messages:
harry (AE): Heads-up: Prospect (GlobalLedger) wants a 3-week POC for contract search + account enrichment. Must handle very long contracts (up to 30k tokens) and support embeddings + rerank + function calls. They requested EU residency and an initial cost ballpark. Kickoff goal: Mon 5/1.

aya (SE): Understood. Clarifying: expected peak QPS for demo? Do they have a golden set for evals or should we create one?

harry (AE): Peak ~120 QPS, steady 20-40. They can share ~150 labeled queries but ask us to expand to ~400.

mohit (SRE): For p95 <700ms on search+rerank at 120 QPS, recommend Dedicated with autoscale headroom. Use prefix/KV caching and continuous batching. For long docs, we should do hybrid retrieval (chunk + long-context pass).

lina (Security): They want SCCQ answers, customer-managed KMS, and log redaction. No raw PII may egress. If they insist on full VPC control, push Private deployment.

aya (SE): Model plan: embeddings model redwood-embed-32k; gen model redwood-gen-32k-q4 for synthesis/tool calls; small cross-encoder for rerank (CPU). We'll run a quick compare 16k vs 32k on samples with long clauses.

mohit (SRE): Cost sketch (3 weeks, Dedicated, q4 quant): ingest/indexing ~$1.0k, serving ~$5.5k, ops ~$900 -> est $7.4k. Private adds integration (~$3k) instead of serving fee.

harry (AE): Acceptance criteria to propose:
- Retrieval QA F1 >= 0.80 on golden set
- Rerank MRR uplift >= 10% vs baseline
- End-to-end p95 search+rerank <700ms on Dedicated
- Tool-call enrichment latency < 400ms
- SCCQ answered + KMS provisioning confirmed

lina (Security): I'll start SCCQ draft and request key contact. Also need their retention policy for logs and a network diagram.

aya (SE): Implementation notes: function call pattern for enrichment, keep PII lookups inside customer environment. Example call: {"name":"get_enrichment","args":{"acct_id":"<id>"}}. We return token-limited summary.

mohit (SRE): I'll prepare Dedicated vs Private one-pager and a canary rollout plan (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with fallback to smaller gen model on overload. ETA for docs: Fri.

harry (AE): Action items:
- aya: prompt templates + run small 16k vs 32k eval (due Wed)
- mohit: cost note + Dedicated vs Private one-pager + canary/runbook (due Fri)
- lina: SCCQ draft + KMS checklist (due Wed)
- harry: proposal + calendar invite for Mon 5/1 kickoff

deploy-bot: calendar invite created for GlobalLedger POC Kickoff Mon 5/1 09:00 UTC.
